· Cause of death: morphine poisoning; blood level roughly ten times the prescribed dose.
· Advanced pancreatic cancer; spread to the liver. Expected survival a few weeks at most.
· The port catheter in the chest connected to the morphine pump; no other needle marks.
· The graze on the forehead occurred shortly before death; consistent with a fall, not a blow.
· No signs of a struggle, no foreign tissue under the nails.
· Time of death: 22.30–00.30.

“To bube Berlin,

If an old man’s death is taken as natural, no one looks in his safe. If it is taken as murder, everyone does. My son would burn the ledger; Sabine would hide it; the men I kept with money are even among you. I fed Matthias Kern; I killed Clara Weiß, not with my own hand but with my own money.

On 3 December 2029 at 07.10, Konrad Arendt (71), founder of Arendt Handelsgesellschaft, was found dead in the study of his villa in Grunewald. Found by the housekeeper, Marta Nowak.

The room in disorder: an overturned chair, a broken garden window, a graze on his forehead, files scattered on the floor. The safe open and empty. The garden camera switched off at 21.55.

Note: The file reached bube Berlin not through the usual channel but in a sealed envelope a notary sent to the branch. On the envelope: “Should Konrad Arendt’s death be found suspicious, to be delivered only to bube Berlin — Kreuzberg Branch.”

· The garden window’s glass is outside, on the lawn; the window was broken from inside. Glass fragments on the iron fire tongs.

SCENE EXAMINATION

The scene examination showed the glass was broken from inside and the safe was not forced. The home panel showed Konrad’s own PIN for the camera and the safe, and the garden camera’s last frames showed him alone. The pump log and toxicology proved the morphine came only from his button; the notarial record and the letter explained why.
A scene is not always a perpetrator’s scene; sometimes the dead man stages his own death as a message. Ask who built it, and whom it was built to reach.
Grunewald, Arendt villa — December 2029

When terminally ill Konrad Arendt learned that his money had got a bube analyst killed in November, he decided to hand over his forty-year ledger; but he knew that after a natural death no one would look in his safe, and that his son would burn the ledger. On 2 December he left the ledger with a notary, with an instruction: if the death is suspicious, to bube Berlin. That night he broke the window from inside, emptied the safe, showed his face to the camera and switched it off, and, releasing the pump lock with the code he had learned from his nurse, gave himself fourteen extra doses.
Who is responsible for Konrad Arendt’s death?

File #024 — The Ledger

All the morphine was given through the pump line, via the port catheter; the loss from the reservoir matches the blood level. No injection from outside. Only Konrad Arendt’s fingerprints on the patient button.
